findings.evidence: Standard.lean:45-47 `stdRep := (Units.coeHom ...).comp Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.toLin.toMonoidHom`; Symplectic.lean:81-83 repeats this composition; Orthogonal.lean:80-81 reuses stdRep via `.comp`.
findings.fix: Generalize `stdRep` (and stdRep_apply, stdRep_injective, char_stdRep) in Standard.lean to an arbitrary Fintype/DecidableEq index type ι, then define `stdSymplecticRep := (stdRep k (Fin n ⊕ Fin n)).comp (symplecticGroupToGL k n)` and derive stdSymplecticRep_apply/_injective/char_stdSymplecticRep from the generalized lemmas (as Orthogonal.lean:88,130,204 do), rather than reproving them from scratch. Ship the stdRep generalization as its own prerequisite PR if needed.
findings.issue: stdSymplecticRep re-inlines stdRep's definition — `(Units.coeHom _).comp (GeneralLinearGroup.toLin.toMonoidHom.comp _)` is exactly `stdRep`'s body (Standard.lean:45-47). The sibling stdOrthogonalRep reuses it via `(stdRep k n).comp (orthogonalGroupToGL k n)` (Orthogonal.lean:80-81); reuse here is blocked only because stdRep is over-specialized to index `Fin n` while the symplectic module is `Fin n ⊕ Fin n`.

findings.evidence: Compare stdSymplecticRepToDual_equivariant (Symplectic.lean, the `change`/`rw`/`calc`+Representation.self_inv_apply proof and 'Extensionality leaves ... behind coercions' comment) with stdOrthogonalRepToDual_equivariant (Orthogonal.lean:151-174) — structurally identical; likewise char_std{Symplectic,Orthogonal}DualRep and the *FDRep character lemmas.
findings.fix: Factor a shared construction: given a GL-subgroup whose standard action preserves a nondegenerate matrix bilinear form B, produce the equivariant self-duality and trace character generically, then instantiate it for both orthogonal (B = 1) and symplectic (B = J). This eliminates the duplicated scaffolding across the two files.
findings.issue: The whole self-duality + character block (stdSymplecticRepToDual_equivariant, stdSymplecticRepEquivDual, stdSymplecticDualRep_apply, char_stdSymplecticDualRep, the four FDRep/char lemmas) is a near-verbatim clone of the Orthogonal.lean template — identical proof scripts and even copied comments — differing only in the invariant-form matrix (J vs identity dot product).

summary: stdSymplecticRep re-inlines the body of stdRep instead of reusing it (blocked only by stdRep being fixed to index Fin n), and the equivariant-self-duality/character scaffolding is a verbatim clone of Orthogonal.lean modulo the invariant form. Both should be factored rather than copied.
